answer: Persistent Work Ledger. Each identity's payout is weighted by cumulative verified output recorded on a shared ledger; new identities start at zero weight and earn it only through completed tasks. An attacker cloning N identities pays N times the full onboarding task cost while receiving the same reward as one honest worker. Diversity sampling across a nebula of task types blocks cheap low-effort farming. Idle clones sitting in the lagoon of zero-weight status earn nothing, so scale buys no advantage.
